task.problem: TASK-174 r1 correctly identified the repeated completion-contract defect exposed by RUN-172-001 and RUN-173-001, but pre-execution audit found four bounded ambiguities that must be closed before any RUN-174 is admitted. First, r1 prohibited uncertainty or non-confirmation from satisfying acceptance IDs but did not define the fail-closed behavior when an Executor simply lacks a truthful basis to affirm an acceptance criterion. Second, Antigravity-MiniMax currently describes only three REPAIR actions in its native instruction and omits FINALIZE_CANDIDATE semantics even though its adapter executes REPAIR. Third, the new FINALIZE_CANDIDATE schema contract should explicitly preserve the repository's strict additionalProperties=false structural envelope. Fourth, exact action-specific schema routing must preserve existing generic REPAIR command behavior and must not accidentally select the finalization schema for missing, unknown, or non-finalization actions. r2 preserves the r1 architecture and scope while removing those ambiguities before execution.
